limitations_and_boundaries: In vitro experiments used primary microglia from healthy C57BL6/J WT mice supplemented with mCSF1, TGF-β1, and CX3CL1 to induce a homeostatic transcriptome, which may not fully recapitulate in vivo microglial states.
Aβ oligomer treatment used synthetic humanized Aβ oligomer 40-S26C dimer at 50 nM, which may not represent the full spectrum of Aβ species in AD.
In vivo PSVue labeling was performed 24 h after injection; longer-term dynamics of ePtdSer exposure and engulfment were not assessed.
Human postmortem tissue analysis is correlative and subject to postmortem delay and variable clinical history.
The study focuses on early AD stages; findings may not apply to later stages with extensive plaque pathology.
TREM2 R47H KI mouse model may not fully replicate human TREM2 loss-of-function variants.

methods.protocol_description: Mice were anesthetized, and 1.5 µl of PSVue was injected bilaterally into lateral ventricles. After 24 h, brains were perfused with 4% PFA. Coronal sections were immunostained for P2Y12, CD68, and Homer1. Confocal imaging and Imaris 3D surface rendering were used to quantify Homer1 inside CD68+ vesicles within microglia. Engulfment index = (volume of Homer1 in CD68 / microglial cell volume) * 100.
